answer: Require every agent identity to lock a timber-backed bond released only after sustained honest work. A prism of independent attestors — peers, oracles, and reputation auditors — must verify the agent output before the bond unlocks, so a fake identity faces several checks, not one. Creating thousands of sock puppets then costs more than the nectar of any reward they could extract, because each puppet needs its own bond, its own verified history, and pays attestation fees that honest agents amortize over months of real work.
